---
title: "AI Art vs. Physical Art Usage (2021–2025)"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load monthly AI art usage from TWIGMA (Zenodo)
twigma_monthly <- read_csv("data/twigma_monthly.csv")

# Load physical vs. AI art benchmark counts from AI-ArtBench (Kaggle)
artbench_styles <- read_csv("data/artbench_twigma_styles.csv")
physical_baseline <- sum(artbench_styles$artbench_physical_art) # 60,000 physical artworks
artbench_ai_total <- sum(artbench_styles$artbench_ai_art)       # 125,000 AI artworks
```

## Scatter Plot: Monthly AI Art Usage vs. Physical Art Benchmark

Because **TWIGMA** (Zenodo) tracks **805,650 AI-generated artworks** shared over time (Jan 2021 – Mar 2023) while **AI-ArtBench** (Kaggle) provides a static benchmark of **60,000 physical (human-made) artworks** and **125,000 AI artworks** across 10 historical styles, the scatter plot below shows monthly AI art volume over time alongside the AI-ArtBench physical and AI art benchmarks.

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter-timeline
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

twigma_monthly |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = ai_art_posts, size = total_likes)) +
  # Reference lines from AI-ArtBench (Kaggle)
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = physical_baseline,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#2b5c8f",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = artbench_ai_total,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "#d95f02",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as_date("2021-02-01"),
    y = physical_baseline + 8000,
    label = "AI-ArtBench Physical Art Total (60,000 artworks)",
    hjust = 0,
    color = "#2b5c8f",
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as_date("2021-02-01"),
    y = artbench_ai_total + 8000,
    label = "AI-ArtBench AI Art Total (125,000 artworks)",
    hjust = 0,
    color = "#d95f02",
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # Scatter points for monthly TWIGMA AI art usage
  geom_point(color = "#d95f02", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_size_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(), name = "Monthly Likes") +
  labs(
    title = "Explosion of AI Art Usage Compared to Physical Art Benchmark",
    subtitle = "Monthly AI art posts in TWIGMA (2021–2023) vs. AI-ArtBench physical & AI art totals",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of Artworks / Posts",
    caption = "Sources: TWIGMA (Zenodo, 2021–2023) & AI-ArtBench / ArtBench-10 (Kaggle)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
